signin.proof: One signature proves this wallet is yours. No gas, no funds moved.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Your sign in, the defaults for new uploads, your YouTube connection, and your data.
settings.descriptionLanguages: Your language, your sign in, the defaults for new uploads, your YouTube connection, and your data.
settings.languageHint: The language VideoMind is shown in. It is saved to your wallet, so it follows you to other devices. Transcripts stay in the language spoken in each video.
settings.languageHintSignedOut: The language VideoMind is shown in, in this browser. Sign in and it is saved to your wallet too.
settings.connectTitle: Connect a wallet to see your settings
settings.connectBody: Your settings belong to your wallet.
settings.signInTitle: Sign in to see your settings
settings.signInBody: Your wallet is connected. One signature proves it is yours. The prompt is at the bottom of the page.
settings.deletedBody: Your videos, notes, profile, live events and connections are gone from VideoMind, and you are signed out. You can sign in again at any time and start empty.
settings.sessions: Signed in on {count, plural, one {# device or browser} other {# devices or browsers}}. This sign in lasts until {until}.
settings.everywhereConfirm: Sign out on every device and browser, this one included?
settings.uploadsHint: What a new upload starts with. You can still change it for each video. Remember my last choice uses what you picked on your last upload in this browser.
settings.uploadsSaved: Saved. New uploads start with these.
settings.youtubeHint: VideoMind only asks for permission to upload to your channel. Publishing happens from each video's page.

youtubeNote.denied: YouTube was not connected because access was not allowed.
youtubeNote.scope: YouTube was not connected because uploading was not allowed.
youtubeNote.expired: The connection took too long. Try again.
youtubeNote.error: YouTube could not be connected. While VideoMind's Google app is in testing, only accounts added as test users can connect.

settings.youtubeDisconnectConfirm: Disconnect YouTube? Videos already on your channel stay there.
settings.youtubeConsent: By connecting, you agree to the <yt>YouTube Terms of Service</yt> and VideoMind's <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
settings.dataHint: How VideoMind handles your information is in the Privacy Policy.
settings.deleteHint: This deletes, at once and for good, everything VideoMind holds about this wallet.
settings.deleteWhat: Deleted: your videos and their files, transcripts, chapters and clips; your collections; your notes and watch places; your profile and settings; your live events with their captions and chat, and your messages in other chats; your YouTube connection (revoked at Google); your sign in.
settings.deleteKept: Not deleted: copies you stored on Shelby (public on a network VideoMind cannot change) and videos you published to YouTube (remove them in YouTube Studio). Usage amounts, without any content, are kept as business records.

card.stoppedHint: Open it to see which step, and retry.
card.deleteBody: It leaves your library. The copy on Shelby stays until its paid period ends.

library.title: Library
library.connectTitle: Connect a wallet to open your library
library.connectBody: Your library belongs to your wallet. The wallet is how VideoMind knows which videos are yours.
library.signInTitle: Sign in to open your library
library.signInBody: Your wallet is connected. One signature proves it is yours, then your videos load. The prompt is at the bottom of the page.
library.loadFailed: The library could not be loaded
library.noPageBody: There is no library page at this address.
library.missingBody: It may have been deleted, or it belongs to a different wallet.
library.firstBody: A lecture, a seminar, a talk. It comes back transcribed and split into chapters, and every sentence becomes searchable.
library.emptyViewBody: Videos with the category {categories} are listed here. Choose the category when you upload, or with Edit details on a video's page.
library.emptyCollectionBody: Choose this collection when you upload, or with Edit details on a video's page.
library.wipeTitle: Delete all {count, plural, one {# video} other {# videos}}?
library.wipeBody: They leave your library. Copies stored on Shelby stay there until their paid period ends.
library.noMatchBody: This box looks at titles and tags only. To find something that was said in a video, use Search.

course.descriptionFailed: The description could not be saved.

courses.title: Courses
courses.description: A course is a collection of videos, such as the lectures of one class. Put a video in one when you upload it, or with Edit details on its page.
courses.deleteEmpty: It has no videos in it.
courses.deleteKeeps: {count, plural, one {Its video stays} other {Its # videos stay}} in your library. Only the collection goes.
courses.createFailed: The collection could not be created.
courses.connectTitle: Connect a wallet to open your courses
courses.connectBody: Your library belongs to your wallet. The wallet is how VideoMind knows which collections are yours.
courses.signInTitle: Sign in to open your courses
courses.signInBody: Your wallet is connected. One signature proves it is yours, then your collections load. The prompt is at the bottom of the page.
courses.loadFailed: Your courses could not be loaded
courses.emptyBody: Name one above, or type a new name in the Collection field when you upload a video.

home.heroBody: Upload a lecture, a seminar or a talk. It comes back transcribed and split into chapters, and every sentence in it becomes something you can search for and jump to.

transcript.text: Every sentence with its time. Click a sentence and the video jumps to it.

chapters.text: The recording is split where the topic changes, so a long video can be scanned like a document.

search.text: Look for something that was said and land on the moment it was said.

questions.text: Ask about a video and get an answer that points to the moments it came from.

ownership.text: The file is stored on Shelby and signed by your wallet, with a proof anyone can check.

example.title: Introduction to Distributed Systems: Lecture 01
example.l1: So far we have assumed that messages always arrive.
example.l2: The network is not reliable, and that single fact shapes everything we do.
example.l3: A message can be late, it can be lost, and it can arrive twice.
example.caption: An example. The yellow marks follow the video as it plays.

home.inLibrary: {count, plural, one {# video} other {# videos}} in your library
home.loadFailed: Your videos could not be loaded
home.searchPlaceholder: Search everything that was said in your videos

uploadPage.title: Upload a video
uploadPage.description: The file goes to your library, is transcribed and split into chapters, and can be stored on Shelby with your wallet.

uploaded.d: The file goes to your library in parts. A dropped connection continues where it stopped.

transcribed.d: Every sentence is written down with the time it was said.

chaptered.d: The recording is split where the topic changes, with a summary and key moments.

stored.d: Your wallet signs the file and it is written to Shelby. This can also be done later.

uploadPage.prepaid: Storage on Shelby is prepaid when you upload, for a fixed number of 24 hour payment periods. Each video's ownership proof shows the date it is paid until.

wallet.declined: You declined the request in your wallet.
wallet.funds: Your wallet needs testnet APT (for gas) and ShelbyUSD (for storage). Fund it from the Shelby faucet, then try again.
wallet.submit: The transaction could not be submitted. This usually means the wallet has no testnet APT or ShelbyUSD yet, or the Shelby network is not answering. Check the Shelby status in the sidebar, fund the wallet from the Shelby faucet if needed, then try again.

upload.connectToStore: Connect your wallet to store the file on Shelby.
upload.expired: This upload expired in storage. Discard it and start again.
upload.signInFirst: Sign in with your wallet first. The prompt is at the bottom of the page.
upload.startFailed: The upload could not be started.
upload.differentFile: That is a different file. The video is {video}, this file is {file}.
upload.tooLarge: That file is over 10 GB. Use a smaller one.
upload.badType: Unsupported format. Use MP4, WebM, MOV, AVI or MKV.

status.waiting: Connection lost. Continuing from {size} when it is back.

upload.connectToUpload: Connect a wallet to upload. Your library belongs to your wallet.
upload.signInToUpload: Sign in with your wallet to upload. The prompt is at the bottom of the page.
upload.storeBody: Your wallet signs the file and it is written to Shelby, which gives the video an ownership proof anyone can check.
upload.approve: Approve the request in your wallet. Keep this page open until it finishes.
upload.held: This video is private, so it was not sent to Shelby. A file stored on Shelby can be read by anyone who has its address. You can still store it there, now or later from the video page.
upload.shelbyTooLarge: This file is {size}. Files over 2 GB cannot be stored on Shelby from the browser yet. The video is safe in your library and plays normally.
upload.later: Do this later and open the video
upload.nothingLost: If the connection drops or this tab closes, nothing is lost. Come back to this page and choose the same file to continue from where it stopped.
upload.anchorBody: Choose the same file again. Your wallet signs it and it is written to Shelby. Nothing is uploaded to the library twice.
upload.anchorBodySize: Choose the same file again ({size}). Your wallet signs it and it is written to Shelby. Nothing is uploaded to the library twice.
upload.anchorPrivate: This video is private. A file stored on Shelby can be read by anyone who has its address.
upload.unfinished: {count, plural, one {An upload was not finished} other {# uploads were not finished}}
upload.unfinishedHint: Choose the same file below to continue from where it stopped.
upload.orClick: or click to choose a file
upload.formats: MP4, WebM, MOV, AVI or MKV, up to {size}

search.title: Search
search.description: Describe what you remember. Each result opens the video at the moment it was said.
search.signInFirst: Sign in with your wallet first. The prompt is at the bottom of the page.
search.failed: Search did not work. Please try again.
search.connectBody: Search looks through your own library, so it needs to know which library is yours.
search.label: Search your library
search.placeholder: Describe what you are looking for
search.idle: Describe it the way you remember it, in your own words. For example: the part where the trade off between consistency and availability is explained.
search.summary: {moments, plural, one {# moment} other {# moments}} in {videos, plural, one {# video} other {# videos}}
search.notIndexed: {count, plural, one {1 of your videos is still being prepared for search and was not searched.} other {# of your videos are still being prepared for search and were not searched.}}
search.noneFiltered: Nothing matches that with these filters. Try all kinds of video and all collections, or other words.
search.none: Nothing in your library matches that. Try describing it in different words.
